title: No cryptographic signature verification — attestation badges are static UI text
evidence: Two UI-only attestation badges: 'ATTESTATION: 0x7f3a...b91e' and 'ATTESTATION VERIFIED' are static JSX strings. The proof page shows 'TEE Attestation' with only static description text. No crypto libraries exist in package.json (only framer-motion, next, react). No ECDSA, Ed25519, or signing/verification imports anywhere in src/. The only verify function is onchainos.ts:94 verifyOtp(code) for OTP verification, not signature verification.
rationale: The app displays 'ATTESTATION VERIFIED' at the CTA phase, but there is zero cryptographic verification code. The attestation hash is a hardcoded string. This is acknowledged as MOCKED in ARCHITECTURE.md Emergency Mode table. Severity capped to P1 per v3 D8 (qualitative persona rule, though P03 is quantitative). In a demo context, this is an expected tradeoff — real TEE attestation requires SGX/TDX hardware and would take weeks to integrate.
fix_guidance: For hackathon: document that TEE attestation is simulated in demo mode. Add 'Simulated TEE Attestation' label instead of 'ATTESTATION VERIFIED'. For production: integrate Marlin Oyster or similar TEE SDK with remote attestation verification.

title: Pre-cached data has no replay protection — same response served to all callers
evidence: 9 static cache files with pre-computed addresses/tx hashes. cacheExists() unconditionally short-circuits API (analyze/route.ts:16). No nonces, timestamps, or session-bound identifiers in cache lookups. Same wallet analysis returned to every caller.
rationale: This is expected for a demo — pre-cached data is the entire design. Any caller sees the same demo data. Not a security issue since data is public mock data. Severity P2 because the demo already has a 'Demo Mode' badge.
fix_guidance: Already mitigated by the pink 'Demo Mode — Pre-computed Data' badge on the landing page. No further fix needed.

title: No weak entropy sources — persona and classifier are fully deterministic
evidence: Zero Math.random(), Date.now(), Date.getTime(), crypto.randomUUID, or crypto.getRandomValues calls in any lib file. persona.ts uses deterministic lookups: ARCHETYPES map, VICES map, confidence sorting. classifier.ts uses deterministic calculations: PnL thresholds, holdDurationDays comparisons, win rate ratios. grep confirmed zero entropy source hits across src/lib/.
rationale: Persona generation and pattern classification are fully deterministic. Correct for a demo where reproducibility matters. No cryptographic randomness needed.
fix_guidance: No change needed. Determinism is appropriate. If cryptographic nonces are added, use Web Crypto API crypto.getRandomValues().

title: No request signing or message integrity protection on API calls
evidence: next.config.ts is empty (no headers(), no CSP). All 4 API routes accept unauthenticated requests with no HMAC, no body hash, no timestamp signing. Client fetch uses relative URLs — plain HTTP in dev, HTTPS on Vercel (auto-enforced). No request signing anywhere.
rationale: In a demo context, this is low risk. Vercel enforces HTTPS in production. The unauthenticated API is by design for easy evaluation. No sensitive data is transmitted.
fix_guidance: Add CSP headers in next.config.ts for production. Add Zod schema validation for POST body. Acceptable for demo.

title: VERCEL_OIDC_TOKEN exposed in .env.local — live deployment JWT with real identifiers
evidence: .env.local contains a live VERCEL_OIDC_TOKEN JWT with embedded: project=alter-ego, owner=damilolas-projects-fafdf859, environment=development, owner_id=team_WiDBceN6VoOQgdZ2jORoLLwN, user_id=GLHPNMf9TIgdZ7d96gCSIFOz, client_id=cl_HYyOPBNtFMfHhaUn9L4QPfTZz6TP47bp. Expires 2026-07-16. No NEXT_PUBLIC_ secrets found. No hardcoded keys in client code.
rationale: The VERCEL_OIDC_TOKEN is a genuine deployment JWT — not a mock. If committed or leaked, grants Vercel deployment access. This is a real secret exposure. Token expires today (2026-07-16) so risk window is closing, but the token was in plaintext for the duration of the hackathon.
fix_guidance: Verify .gitignore excludes .env.local. Rotate the OIDC token via Vercel dashboard. Use Vercel Environment Variables UI instead of .env.local for deployment tokens going forward.
